answer: Proposal: each epoch, a key earns rewards only if it burned fee F on-chain that epoch; the ledger checks inclusion; burned coins have no recipient, so fees can't be rebated. F re-sets to last epoch's marginal share R/(H+1) (R pool, H keys), riding the headcount tide. n clones pay nF yet earn nR/(H+n) < nF: each clone past the first returns less than its fee — a knoll of clones or a mountain alike. Honest keys bear F, netting R/(H(H+1)) — thin. Like juniper berries ripening a season late, F lags the census one epoch; clones counted in H erode it; a patient flood recoups.
